$comment: Golden cases of the atlas (tools/check_nui_snapshots.py): one map's atlas with its title. The map view is the 256 x 256 stand-in tools/nui_view_fixtures.py makes (--view), whose size is the view's natural size; the classic frame art is under d:/ymir work/ (assets/ETC). The modern and cyberpunk frames are taller than classic's, so the window's shadow stays inside the frame (a shadow the frame's edge cuts stretches the window's background in nuitool's renderer).
